create_euler_ancestral_scheduler: create an EulerAncestralDiscreteScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and inference steps
set_timesteps_euler_ancestral: set the discrete timesteps for the EulerAncestralDiscreteScheduler before running inference
step_euler_ancestral: perform one denoising step using the EulerAncestralDiscreteScheduler with model output and sample
scale_model_input_euler_ancestral: scale the denoising model input by sigma for the EulerAncestralDiscreteScheduler
add_noise_euler_ancestral: add noise to original samples using the EulerAncestralDiscreteScheduler noise schedule
